hypotheses.A1_prospective_causality: At least two of three categories selected only by cross-seed leading-mode recurrence have top-1 causal fidelity at least 0.20 and beat their complementary bulk.
hypotheses.A2_prospective_control_advantage: The selected semantic top-1 median causal fidelity exceeds norm-matched nonsemantic feature controls by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.A3_prospective_semantics: Across available held-out corpora, selected top-1 scores have median oriented AUROC at least 0.70 and lose no more than 0.10 relative to the full quadratic form.
hypotheses.A4_all_category_matching: Across all nine previously untested categories, exact cross-seed leading-mode assignment has permutation p at most 0.05 and at least six of nine diagonal matches rank first.
hypotheses.A5_significant_only: Null-exceeding modes for the selected semantic directions have median causal fidelity at least 0.20 and exceed selected matched controls by at least 0.10; zero-spike directions count as zero.
